span.p:
Regional Snapshot (per candidate region r)
free_slots · reserved_quantity · quota_headroom · quota_limit
customer_count · total_customers · dr_coverage_ratio · az_count

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
α_comp = Clamp(nonprod_crg.effective_free / prod_crg.quantity)
NonProd headroom signal

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
β_comp = Clamp(prod_crg.quota_headroom / prod_crg.quota_limit)
Prod quota headroom

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
γ_comp = Clamp(1 − prod_customer_count / total_customers)
Distribution fairness

span.p:
Clamping applied to every component
Clamp(x) = max(0, min(1, x))

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weighted Sum
PS = 0.30·α + 0.20·β + 0.25·γ + 0.15·δ + 0.10·ε
weights must sum to 1.0 → PS ∈ [0,1]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Seed Record
Prod anchor selected → derives DR → then CVAL
(sequential Prod → NonProd → DR)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tie-break: deterministic —
first region in the Standard Capacity Region
list order for that geography

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Formula variants (same weights, different signals):
• PS_Prod: α uses nonprod effective_free / prod quantity; δ = dr coverage_ratio
• PS_NonProd: α & δ use nonprod effective_free / nonprod quantity
• PS_DR: α = dr free/qty; δ = min(1, coverage_ratio / dr_ratio_target)
See Calculation Logic Reference v2.2
